candidates.title: Pet Certificate Signature & Customization Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout where users physically sign the certificate and set initial personality traits before completing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is low (63.2%) with users spending a long time (mean 1017s) and 3 support emails reporting pet custom generation issues.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Sign your name and confirm your companion's core personality traits.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[1]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Tutorial Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated post-onboarding tutorial screen showing interactive demonstrations of how to control, hide, and talk to your desktop pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3 tickets) report confusion after setup about controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

new_pet_controls.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Controls
new_pet_controls.body: Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click to open actions or hide to system tray.

components.text: Right-click to talk, feed, or minimize your pet to system tray anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a post-onboarding tutorial screen after home_intro is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off (35.2%) at finish step with 3 support tickets, but requires a brand new screen.

candidates.title: Path Choice Split Screen Comparison
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a split layout contrasting preset companion pets with custom AI pet generation side-by-side.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s and 18.3% drop-off as users struggle to compare onboarding paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Create Your Companion
choose_path.body: Pick a quick ready-made companion pet or create a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Guided Photo Quality Verification Flow
candidates.change: Insert a photo verification step right after photo upload to test and preview image clarity before generating the custom pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 36.8% drop-off during adoption.

new_photo_verify.headline: Photo Quality Check
new_photo_verify.body: We analyzed your photo to ensure smooth 3D pet rendering.

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality verification step within onboarding is allowed and preserves all mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at large adoption drop-off (36.8%), though adding new flow steps increases friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Pre-Launch Diagnostic Screen
candidates.change: Add a desktop rendering diagnostic step before home intro to ensure the overlay layer launches properly above windows.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report pets not appearing on the desktop or the app failing to open properly on initial launch.

new_render_check.headline: Verifying Desktop Display Support
new_render_check.body: Ensuring your pet will overlay smoothly above your open desktop windows.

guard.reason: Adding a pre-launch diagnostic screen before home intro is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses rendering bug reports but adds heavy friction with a new screen for 18.7% drop-off.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display an prominent account hint clarifying that signing into an existing account restores saved pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the #1 complaint theme) report missing or reset pets after signing back in with the wrong account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account to automatically restore all your existing pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adding an account recovery hint on the sign-in screen is compliant with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: #1 support complaint theme and easy config/copy hint, but sign_in drop-off is relatively low (9.9%).

candidates.title: Generation Time Estimate & Progress Tracker
candidates.change: Enable live time estimates and step progress counters on the waiting screen while building pet assets.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s) and 18.7% drop-off due to uncertain waiting periods.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet...
waiting.body: Compiling 3D animations and desktop physics. This usually takes under 3 minutes.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators and estimated time for a real pet generation wait complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high mean latency (2336s) during home generation wait period.

candidates.title: First-Day Accessory Reward Callout
candidates.change: Display a welcome bonus accessory badge on the final home screen to encourage users to complete setup.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops 35.2% with a mean duration of 5815s; incentives boost immediate completion.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready! Claim Free Accessory
home_intro.body: Welcome your pet to the desktop to unlock an exclusive starter hat accessory.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'Free Accessory', violating rule 3.

candidates.title: Path Reassurance Story Copy
candidates.change: Update story screen text to inform users they can create additional pets or change styles later in settings.
candidates.why: Users hesitate on choose_path (mean 514s) fearing their initial choice permanently locks their pet options.

guard.reason: Switching to a grid layout retains the pet selection functionality required for Pick a Friend.

candidates.score_note: Tackles largest funnel drop-off (36.8%) and long selection time (1017s) with clean grid UI.
